title: How a toilet flushes
caption: Your toilet is a siphon machine 🚽 #howitworks #toilet #plumbing #howitsbuilt #learnontiktok

lines.text: If a toilet were just a bowl with a hole in it, your bathroom would smell like a sewer.
So the pipe bends up and back down, and that bend always holds a little water, which blocks the gas.
But now everything just sits there in the bowl.
So you dump in a big rush of water, all at once.
It fills the bend so fast that it starts a *siphon*, which sucks everything down the pipe.
Then it gurgles, and the bend refills with clean water.
But the pipe in the wall can't deliver that much water that fast, so you store it in a *tank*.
A rubber *flapper* plugs the bottom, and when you push the handle, a chain yanks it open.
But then the tank is empty.
So a *float* rides on the water. When it drops, it opens the fill valve, and when it rises, it shuts it off.
But if that valve ever sticks open, the tank overflows onto your floor.
So an *overflow tube* sends the extra water into the bowl instead.
And every flush pulls on the pipes so hard it could suck the water out of your sink drains.
So a *vent pipe* runs up through the roof and lets air in.
